title: Residue and quotient algebra data
statement: The residue-field structures and quotient algebra structure required in the surjective local quotient construction exist.

proof.text: Take L to be the canonical separable closure of the residue field of B. Compose its residue-field algebra map with the residue map of B, and use IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' to obtain the scalar tower. For J = I.map (algebraMap A C), the composite A → C → C/J kills ker π = I by Ideal.mem_map_of_mem and Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem. RingHom.liftOfSurjective then descends this composite to B → C/J; RingHom.toAlgebra supplies the required algebra. All objects are explicitly constructed from proved Mathlib declarations.

proof_origin.place: Tag 05WS; auxiliary data construction using Mathlib RingHom.liftOfSurjective and SeparableClosure
